intro_h2: Home & Room Additions in Los Angeles County
intro: When you love your neighborhood but need more space, a room addition is often smarter than moving. Palm Crest Builders designs and builds seamless additions across Los Angeles County — primary suites, extra bedrooms, expanded family rooms, and full second stories. As a licensed general building contractor we handle foundation, framing, roofing tie-ins, and interior finishes so the new space matches your existing home inside and out, and meets every structural and energy code.

body_extra.heading: First-Floor vs. Second-Story Additions
body_extra.text: A ground-floor addition is usually simpler and less expensive, but it uses up yard space and requires available lot area within your setbacks. A second-story addition preserves your lot but adds cost for structural reinforcement, a new staircase, and temporary weather protection. During your consultation we'll evaluate your lot, foundation, and goals and recommend the approach that gives you the most usable space for your budget.

faqs.q: How long does a room addition take?
faqs.a: A single-room, first-floor addition typically takes 2–4 months. Larger suites and second-story additions run 4–7 months including permitting.

faqs.q: Will the addition match my existing home?
faqs.a: Yes — matching rooflines, stucco or siding, windows, and interior finishes is a core part of our work so the addition looks original.
Almost always. We include engineering and Title 24 energy calculations, and handle plan check and permits as part of the project.
